title: Five Star — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Five Star.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "American Made." Specialty tier. Five Star (Brown Stove Works) makes pro-style gas and dual-fuel ranges in Cleveland, Tennessee. American-made with open burners and commercial aesthetics at lower prices than BlueStar and Wolf.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: American-made pro-style on a budget. Open-burner cooking at value pricing.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Five Star:

• Made in Cleveland, Tennessee — genuine American manufacturing

• Open burners at prices well below BlueStar

• Pro-style aesthetics at mid-range pricing

• Self-clean oven available

• Traditional American range heritage
